name: ppo_to_az
description: Train the PPO generalist to a plateau across the full 7-archetype league roster (PopArt ON, since the diverse matchup value scales are exactly what per-bucket PopArt cancels), inoculate it against the two most distinct value landscapes (burn race, doomsday combo) via frozen-gen exploiters, consolidate them back into gen with a second league, gate the result vs scripted:hard across the whole field, then warm-start an AZ league that rotates mixed-matchup self-play indefinitely. The AZ phase is terminal (rotations:0) so it runs until you Ctrl-C it at ~24h; resume with `curriculum --plan ppo_to_az --resume` to extend it. Step budgets are scaled ~2.4x off the 10M-timestep midrange-only anchor because the roster now spans all 7 archetypes (up to 64 value buckets) rather than a few midrange cells; tune them after watching explained_variance.

phases.label: inoculate-burn
phases.note: exp_burn learner pilots the burn archetype vs the frozen gen; the next league folds it in as a never-evicted pool entry.

phases.label: inoculate-doomsday
phases.note: Combo axis: a value landscape very unlike the aggro/midrange bulk.

phases.label: consolidate
phases.note: Fresh league run (auto-continues gen__final.zip) that now sees both exploiters in its opponent pool, hardening gen against burn/combo. Brings gen to ~24M total steps.

phases.label: ppo-gate
phases.note: Full NxN round-robin of gen vs scripted:hard across the roster, appended to baseline_report.log. Sanity-check the PPO generalist BEFORE spending ~24h of MCTS warm-starting from it.

phases.label: az-24h
phases.note: Warm-starts from the PPO gen. rotations:0 runs indefinitely over the full roster; mirror_frac 0.25 keeps ~75% of self-play games cross-deck (mixed matchups). bo3 by default. Ctrl-C at ~24h; --resume to extend.
